model_visible.headline: The Agent Said It Was Done. The Database Disagreed.
model_visible.excerpt: Microsoft and Hugging Face present ThinkingBox, which grades agents by terminal database state and repeated outcomes rather than plausible text or valid-looking tool calls.

model_visible.headline: Selected models in GitHub Copilot deprecated
model_visible.excerpt: GitHub lists four Copilot model deprecations effective October 2 and directs organizations to enable supported alternatives in model policies.

model_visible.headline: Copilot code review: API support and new default effort level
model_visible.excerpt: GitHub adds REST and GraphQL requests for Copilot code review, per-request effort settings, and makes Balanced the default review effort.

model_visible.headline: Find your learning tools all in one place with the student hub in Gemini
model_visible.excerpt: Google Workspace makes Gemini’s student hub available to education accounts, centralizing learning tools under the existing generative-AI administration controls.

model_visible.headline: Product Announcements Workspace Drops: Pro-level AI image creation and editing, new ways to make your data interactive, and more AI help across your apps By The Google Workspace Team • 3-minute read
model_visible.excerpt: Google’s September Workspace feature drop adds object-level AI image editing, prompt-built Sheets canvases, cross-app task execution, Vids explainers and AI data classification.

model_visible.headline: Open-sourcing AstaBrief, the fast report-generation model in Asta
model_visible.excerpt: Ai2 open-sources AstaBrief 8B and training data for citation-grounded scientific reports, reporting a one-pass pipeline and materially faster report generation.

model_visible.headline: Build Applications on NVIDIA BlueField Faster with NVIDIA DOCA Agent Skills
model_visible.excerpt: NVIDIA describes machine-readable DOCA skills with verified API signatures, hardware constraints and build checks; its 65-prompt evaluation reports large reliability gains.

model_visible.headline: Fine-tune a search agent with multi-turn RL on Amazon SageMaker AI
model_visible.excerpt: AWS demonstrates multi-turn reinforcement learning for a search agent, optimizing full tool-use trajectories with verifiable retrieval rewards and production observability.

model_visible.headline: Building ambient agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: From event-driven signals to human-in-the-loop workflows
model_visible.excerpt: AWS details event-driven ambient agents that react to signals, isolate sessions, pause for human approval and resume through a canonical interruption contract.
